messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: INCIDENT INC-2026-042 - billing-metering pipeline degraded. Error rate spiked on metering-ingest; ingestion throughput ~20% of baseline. Root cause unknown. Paging @alex (oncall), @priya (sre). Thread created 1761234567.

alex (oncall): I see the alerts. UI shows a lot of tenants with 0 usage since 03:12 UTC. Metrics: ingest-errors ~ 400/min, backlog ~ 18k msgs. Starting investigation.

maya (billing): Heard from finance — delayed invoices are starting to pile up. We already have a queue of customers asking why invoices aren't showing. Rough estimate: ~120 tenants impacted on hosted plan.

kevin (support): Got a high-priority ticket from Acme. They say last invoice showed 0 usage then a negative adjustment. Can we confirm if any reconciles created negative numbers?

priya (sre): grabbing logs now. Initial hypothesis: downstream aggregator failing to ack Kafka messages causing duplicates on re-ingest path -> billing projection mismatch. Running quick health checks then we'll attempt a canary restart of metering-ingest.

alex (oncall): commands I'm running:
```
kubectl -n metering rollout status deploy/metering-ingest
kubectl -n metering logs deploy/metering-ingest --since=2h | grep ERROR | tail -n 200
```

priya (sre): canary restarted worker on eu-west-1 at 03:28 UTC, logs show immediate drop in NACKs. Pushing restart to us-west-2 now.

ops-bot: Automation note: reprocess job queued (reconcile-window job id 9843). Backfill will rehydrate usage from 2026-03-01T03:00Z to 2026-03-01T06:00Z. Estimated runtime ~3 hours for full backlog.

alex (oncall): restart completed in all regions at 03:35 UTC. ingest-errors down to ~15/min, backlog processing pace ~1.2k msgs/min. Starting controlled reprocess for earliest affected windows.

statusbot: DRAFT status page update: "Investigating — We are aware some customers may see incorrect usage totals or delayed invoices. Our engineers are actively reconciling usage data; ingest services have been restarted and backlog processing is underway. We estimate reconciliation may complete within ~4 hours. Updates to follow." Please review.

maya (billing): Draft customer-facing email (for support to send or paste):
Subject: Temporary Billing Discrepancy — We're Investigating

Hi <customer_name>,

We detected a system issue that may have temporarily affected usage reporting and invoice generation. We have restarted the ingestion service and are reprocessing affected records. You may see corrected usage and an updated invoice within the next several hours. We apologize for the disruption and are monitoring closely.

If you need immediate help or a provisional credit, reply here and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
The Redwood Billing Team

(Feel free to add specific customer context) :email:

kevin (support): I'll send that to Acme and offer a provisional credit while we reconcile. What should we say about negative adjustments?

maya (billing): Negative adjustments likely came from a partial reprocess overlap; we're blocking auto-adjustments for now and will only apply reconciliation deltas after validation. For Acme: offer credit and say we'll confirm corrected invoice by EOD.

priya (sre): operational note: to avoid double-apply we put auditing flag audit.reconcile.disable_auto_apply=true and paused the downstream invoice-apply worker at 03:40 UTC. Reprocess is writing to staging reconciliation table for manual review.

alex (oncall): current status: ingest stable, backlog processing ongoing. Reconcile job progress: 32% complete (processing earliest windows first). No new customer-facing negatives detected since pause.

ops-bot: Reminder: on-call handoff in 2h. @alex please handoff summary and next steps to the incoming oncall.

alex (oncall): Handing off to @priya (next oncall) at 05:15 UTC. Summary:
- Incident INC-2026-042: metering ingestion errors caused delayed/incorrect usage displays.
- Mitigation: restarted ingest workers (03:35 UTC), paused auto-apply, queued backfill/reconcile job id 9843.
- Current: reconcile 32% complete, estimated completion 2.5h.
- Action for next shift: validate reconciliation sample for 10 large tenants, enable auto-apply only after manual signoff, coordinate customer emails for any tenants with >$5k variance.

priya (sre): taking over. I'll continue recon and coordinate with maya/kevin for customer comms. Will post hourly updates.

kevin (support): Confirmed email sent to Acme, offered provisional credit. They acknowledged. Will route any escalations here. :thumbsup:

maya (billing): finance wants a reconciliation CSV and notes for audit. We'll need: tenant_id, original_usage, reconciled_usage, delta, action_taken. Priya, can you generate once backfill completes?

priya (sre): yes — I'll add export step: `GET /internal/metering/reconcile/export?job=9843&format=csv` and drop to secure S3 with link to billing.

ops-bot: UPDATE: Reconcile job 9843 completed at 1761234789. Post-run validation shows 94% match vs expected; 48 tenants flagged for manual review.

alex (oncall): manual review done for 48 flagged tenants. 45 had small deltas (<$50), 3 required adjustment (Acme included). Applied manual corrections and generated reconciliation CSV.

maya (billing): sent reconciliation CSV to finance and accounting with notes. Will convert into credits where appropriate.

statusbot: STATUS UPDATE: Identified — The ingestion pipeline experienced transient failures that resulted in delayed and temporarily incorrect usage reporting for a subset of customers. Ingestion services were restarted and backlog reprocessed. Most customers will see updated usage and invoices; for customers with manual adjustments we will communicate individually. Incident resolved at 1761234890.

priya (sre): root cause (preliminary): consumer offset commit regression after a library upgrade in the aggregator service led to skipped commits under high load. Patch submitted (PR #789) to add commit idempotency and increased consumer visibility metrics.

alex (oncall): resolution checklist:
- restart & stabilize ingest (done)
- pause auto-apply (done)
- reprocess/validate (done)
- manual review and adjustments (done)
- customer comms (support + billing) (in progress/done for top customers)

kevin (support): Acme confirmed invoice corrected and accepted provisional credit. Closing their ticket.

maya (billing): finance acknowledged reconciled CSV. We'll queue any refunds/credits in next billing run.

priya (sre): post-incident actions assigned:
- add additional consumer commit metrics and alerts (priya)
- add automated reconcile job health dashboard (alex)
- run chaos test for consumer regression (eng-qa)
- add runbook step to pause auto-apply automatically on reconcile start (maya+priya)

alex (oncall): handing back to normal rotation. Great job team. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-042 marked RESOLVED at 1761234890. Please submit postmortem notes in #postmortems within 72h.

priya (sre): I'll draft the postmortem and include reconciliation CSV and timeline.

maya (billing): tagging finance and support for follow-ups.

kevin (support): closing thread after postmortem link posted.
